blind.description: An ornate long upholstered bench consisting of a plush, rectangular red velvet/leather cushion top mounted on an intricately carved wooden apron with decorative spherical studs/beading, supported by eight curved cabriole-style wooden legs (four along each side). The surfaces are solid, continuous, and finished in rich crimson upholstery and glossy varnished brown wood.
blind.from_above: A simple elongated rectangular crimson red shape with slightly rounded corners, flanked underneath by subtle protrusions of the carved wooden legs.
blind.height_vs_figure: Stands around shin-to-knee height (about 1.3 to 1.5 ft tall, roughly 1/4 of the 5 ft 9 in figure's height) and measures roughly 4.5 to 5 ft long.
